cd . && python3 - <<'EOF'
from plugins.base import PluginError
from plugins.json_plugin import JsonPlugin
from plugins.json_fields import flatten

p = JsonPlugin()
# supports
for s, exp in [("json", True), ("csv", False), ("CSV", False), (None, False), (1, False), ("JSON", False)]:
    assert p.supports(s) is exp, (s, p.supports(s))
# nested flatten
assert p.parse('{"a": {"b": 1}}') == [{"key": "a.b", "value": "1"}]
assert p.parse('{"a": 1}') == [{"key": "a", "value": "1"}]
# deep
assert p.parse('{"a": {"b": {"c": {"d": true}}}}') == [{"key": "a.b.c.d", "value": "True"}]
# leaf conversions
assert p.parse('{"s": " x ", "i": 3, "f": 2.5, "t": true, "f2": false, "n": null}') == [
    {"key": "s", "value": " x "},
    {"key": "i", "value": "3"},
    {"key": "f", "value": "2.5"},
    {"key": "t", "value": "True"},
    {"key": "f2", "value": "False"},
    {"key": "n", "value": ""},
]
# empty nested object emits nothing
assert p.parse('{"a": {}, "b": {"c": {}}, "d": 1}') == [{"key": "d", "value": "1"}]
assert p.parse('{}') == []
# insertion order preserved
assert [r["key"] for r in p.parse('{"z": 1, "a": {"y": 2, "b": 3}}')] == ["z", "a.y", "a.b"]
# bytes ok
assert p.parse(b'{"a": 1}') == [{"key": "a", "value": "1"}]
# rejections
bad = ['{not json', '', '[1,2]', '"str"', '5', 'true', 'null', None, 5, {}, [], b'{bad']
for b in bad:
    try:
        p.parse(b)
    except PluginError:
        pass
    except Exception as e:
        raise AssertionError("bare %r for %r" % (e, b))
    else:
        raise AssertionError("accepted %r" % (b,))
# transform
assert p.transform({"key": " A ", "value": " v "}) == {"key": "A", "value": "v"}
assert p.transform({"key": " A ", "value": " V "}, {"lowercase": True}) == {"key": "a", "value": "V"}
assert p.transform({"key": "A", "value": "V"}, {"lowercase": False}) == {"key": "A", "value": "V"}
assert p.transform({"key": 1, "value": None}) == {"key": "1", "value": "None"}
for rec in [{"key": "a"}, {"value": "b"}, {}, None, 5, ["k", "v"]]:
    try:
        p.transform(rec)
    except PluginError:
        pass
    except Exception as e:
        raise AssertionError("bare %r for %r" % (e, rec))
    else:
        raise AssertionError("accepted rec %r" % (rec,))
# flatten direct
assert flatten({"a": {"b": 1}}) == {"a.b": "1"}
print("all ok")
EOF
